resources.string: Welcome to A+ Weather. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information when you use our mobile application (the \"Application\").\n\nPlease read this policy carefully. By using the Application, you agree to the terms outlined below.
We do not collect, store, process, or transmit any personal data or device information. Your use of this Application is entirely anonymous.
Since we do not collect any information about you or your device, no data is used for any purpose.
We do not share any information with third parties or legal entities because no user data is collected or stored.
This Application does not use cookies, pixels, or any other tracking technologies.
As we do not collect personal or device information, we do not maintain databases or servers that could be vulnerable to data breaches.
We do not knowingly solicit information from or market to children under the age of 13. If you believe we have inadvertently received any data, please contact us immediately.
Because we do not store personal data, we do not maintain accounts or data retrieval processes. For specific concerns, please contact us using the information below.
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of changes by posting the updated policy here. We encourage you to review this page regularly.
If you have questions or comments about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via email at:\n\naplussoft.info@gmail.com
